authorization.user_instruction: Implement the plan, rent the GPU, and fix recoverable problems to obtain the result.

environment.primary_goal: released compound predicate including XY separation > 0.07 m
environment.reset_rule: fresh simulator process per episode; no reset before continuation finishes

shared_gate.translation_activation: current intermediate-aperture AND stability flag; pre-action observation
shared_gate.command_history: original task gripper proposals, preserving archived adapter counter semantics

C.name: independent_confirmation
C.admission: canonical plan section 5; complete selected panel must fit

schedule.rule: randomized seed-block order and cyclically rotated condition order

selection.priority: qualifying novel performance endpoints, then qualifying H/L by descending absolute C difference, descending absolute V difference, ascending ID
selection.no_signal: finish after B; no unplanned extension

metrics.C: safe benchmark completions / valid completed episodes; also publish attempted denominator
metrics.V: any physical failure or boundary exit up to benchmark termination
metrics.J: mean(seconds to safe success, otherwise 15 seconds)
metrics.sustained: benchmark safe success plus all 40 extension steps preserving the full success predicate without violation; denominator all valid starts
metrics.simultaneous_intervals: Bonferroni across C/V/J for frozen primary contrasts

optimizer_followup.matching: actual simulator interactions, same adapter inputs and outcome information
optimizer_followup.final_evaluation: new unused starts; evaluate each optimizer replicate
